rule: OPEN GROUPS ONLY. 1:1 chats must NEVER be opened (opening marks them read and sends read receipts): report them from the list preview instead. Which chats are groups is NOT decided by this file — window.groupNames() reads it from WhatsApp itself.
NEVER_where: The groups that must never be opened are listed in helpers.js (window.NEVER by name, window.NEVER_WITH by members), not here: they are pasted into the page together with the code, so no run can forget them.
